narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Guessing is pointless when a protractor is there to tell us.
<bookmark mark='tool'/>But a protractor is not always in your hand, and a guess can catch a wrong reading.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A trained eye tells you roughly how big an angle is before you measure it.
